newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Investimentos sees 96 cons net 13.9 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Investimentos sees 96 cons net 13.9 bln esc.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos, Portugal's biggest industrial group, on Monday forecast a 1996 consolidated net profit after minorities of 13.9 billion escudos, compared with 12.9 billion in 1995.
The company said it expected consolidated profit without extraordinaries after minorities to stand at 8.3 billion escudos in 1996, compared with 4.6 billion in 1995.
It also said it expected consolidated sales of 460 billion escudos in 1996, up from 357 billion in 1995.
